---
import "../generated-experiences/selected/styles.css";
import "../styles/creative-runtime.css";
import CreativeCandidateHost from "./CreativeCandidateHost";
import site from "../lib/site";

const { experience } = Astro.props;
const candidateId = site.design?.experience?.candidateId || "selected";
const diagnostic = import.meta.env.PUBLIC_CREATIVE_DIAGNOSTIC === "true";
const runtime = {
  candidateId,
  diagnostic,
  lead: {
    apiUrl: diagnostic ? "" : site.lead?.apiUrl || "",
    token: diagnostic ? "" : site.lead?.token || "",
  },
  reviews: {
    apiUrl: site.socialProof?.google?.apiUrl || "",
    token: site.socialProof?.google?.token || "",
  },
};
---

<div
  role="main"
  data-creative-host="true"
  data-creative-renderer="creative-candidate"
  data-creative-diagnostic={diagnostic ? "true" : undefined}
  data-creative-candidate={candidateId}
  data-creative-family={site.design?.experience?.familyId || "unknown"}
  data-creative-reference-family={site.design?.experience?.referenceFamilyId || site.design?.experience?.familyId || "unknown"}
>
  <CreativeCandidateHost
    client:load
    content={experience.content}
    runtime={runtime}
  />
</div>
